params.caption: 🎮 Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake is already 2026's best-selling physical game in the US One week on store shelves was enough: the Switch 2 remake has jumped to the top of this year's US physical sales, ahead of every other 2026 release. It follows Nintendo's earlier figure of 5.2 million copies sold worldwide in its first four days, a Switch 2 record. 🕒 Nov 17, 2026 · 03:44 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ 👥 @NintendoAmerica 📦 Physical or digital?
